prompt: A vertical amateur snapshot on cheap colour negative film, taken at night from across a damp British terraced street. A small corner shop glows alone, the only lit window on the whole row; every house around it is dark. A hand-written paper sign is taped inside the glass, unreadable. Fluorescent tubes spill a cold blue-teal light onto the wet pavement, a far-off sodium streetlamp gives a weak orange. The shop door is propped open and nobody is inside or outside. Slightly underexposed, heavy grain, soft focus, faint halation round the tubes, horizon a little tilted. Unglamorous and lonely, like a photo taken walking home. No people, no brands. Thanks.
